title: 三要素法求电阻电流
statement: 图示电路中 Us = 18 V，R1 = 6 kΩ，R2 = 3 kΩ，C = 100 µF。开关 S 原来断开，电路已稳定；t = 0 时 S 闭合。
用三要素法求 R2 中的电流 i_2(t)：分别求 i_2(0₊)、i_2(∞)、τ，以及 t = 0.1 s 时的 i_2。

questions.explain: t < 0 时 R1 中无电流，u_C(0₋) = 18 V；S 闭合瞬间 u_C(0₊) = 18 V 直接加在 R2 上：i_2(0₊) = 18/3 = 6 mA（注意 i_2(0₋) = 0，i_2 跃变了）。
Us 短路，从电容看进去 R_eq = R1 ∥ R2 = 2 kΩ，τ = 2×10³ × 100×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s。

hints: 三要素法对电路中任何一个电压、电流都成立：f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0₊) − f(∞)]e^(−t/τ)。
初值必须用 0₊ 等效电路求：先求 u_C(0₋)，再把电容换成电压源 u_C(0₊)。不要用 i_2(0₋)！
同一个一阶电路里，所有响应的 τ 都一样。
solution: **1. 求 u_C(0₋)。** S 断开时电容开路，R1 中无电流：u_C(0₋) = Us = 18 V。
**2. 0₊ 等效电路。** 电容换成 18 V 电压源，S 闭合：u_a(0₊) = 18 V，**i_2(0₊) = 18/3 kΩ = 6 mA**；R1 两端电压为零，i_R1(0₊) = 0，所以 i_C(0₊) = −6 mA（电容向 R2 放电）。

en.title: Three-element method for a resistor current
statement: In the circuit, Us = 18 V, R1 = 6 kΩ, R2 = 3 kΩ, C = 100 µF. Switch S is open and the circuit is in steady state; S closes at t = 0.
Use the three-element method to find the current i_2(t) in R2: find i_2(0+), i_2(∞), τ, and i_2 at t = 0.1 s.

questions.explain: For t < 0 no current flows in R1, so u_C(0−) = 18 V; when S closes, u_C(0+) = 18 V appears directly across R2: i_2(0+) = 18/3 = 6 mA (note i_2(0−) = 0 — i_2 jumps).
In steady state the capacitor is open and R1, R2 are in series: i_2(∞) = 18/(6 + 3) = 2 mA.
Short Us; seen from the capacitor R_eq = R1 ∥ R2 = 2 kΩ, τ = 2×10³ × 100×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s.

hints: The three-element formula holds for any voltage or current in the circuit: f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0+) − f(∞)]e^(−t/τ).
The initial value must come from the 0+ equivalent circuit: find u_C(0−) first, then replace the capacitor by a voltage source u_C(0+). Don't use i_2(0−)!
In a first-order circuit every response has the same τ.
solution: **1. Find u_C(0−).** With S open the capacitor is open and R1 carries no current: u_C(0−) = Us = 18 V.

**2. 0+ equivalent circuit.** Replace the capacitor by an 18 V source, with S closed: u_a(0+) = 18 V, **i_2(0+) = 18/3 kΩ = 6 mA**; there is no voltage across R1, so i_R1(0+) = 0 and i_C(0+) = −6 mA (the capacitor discharges into R2).
**3. Final value.** Capacitor open: **i_2(∞) = 18/9 kΩ = 2 mA**, u_C(∞) = 6 V.
**4. Time constant.** R_eq = R1 ∥ R2 = 2 kΩ, **τ = 0.2 s**.
